name: Grilled stream fish
summary: Small fish from the valley streams are marinated with forest leaves, mắc khén, chili, and lemongrass, then grilled until fragrant and crisp, with sweet flesh.
origin: The streams of Pù Luông. Sources: the Vietnam Airlines travel guide; VnExpress, 3 Jul 2023.
taste: Fragrant and crisp from the grill; the stream fish itself is sweet.
howToEat: Wrap the grilled fish with forest greens, fresh rice noodles, cucumber, and carrot, and dip it in a sweet-sour fish sauce.
Thai cooks also make a soup of fish with măng chua, onion, fish sauce, salt, and pepper.
where: The valley meal. Some Thai hosts run a cooking session that includes grilling stream fish.
seoTitle: Grilled stream fish in Pu Luong — leaves, then the coals
seoDescription: Cá suối nướng is small stream fish marinated with forest leaves, mắc khén, chili, and lemongrass, then grilled.
